inputs.mainTasks: Review weekly metrics, coordinate incident responses, coach team members, set operating priorities

result.summary: Routine reporting and coordination account for a meaningful part of this example role. AI could reduce the time spent gathering information and preparing updates. The more useful question is how that changes the manager’s responsibility for judgment, coaching, and decisions.

exposed_tasks.reason: Collecting metrics and drafting a first summary are repeatable activities. Setting priorities and deciding what to do about an exception still need context.
AI could gather updates and highlight overdue actions, while the manager handles exceptions and competing commitments.

protected_tasks.task: Decide how to respond to an operational incident
Coach a team through a change in responsibilities

skill_gaps.action: Compare one AI-generated review with your own analysis. Record missed context and unsupported claims.

skill_gaps.skill: Redesign a workflow around human review
skill_gaps.action: Map who reviews an AI output, what evidence they need, and when to escalate.

thirty_day_plan.title: Observe the actual work
thirty_day_plan.actions: Track the time spent collecting information, drafting updates, and making decisions. Ask the team where repeated work gets in the way.
thirty_day_plan.output: A simple task and time map.

thirty_day_plan.title: Try one bounded change
thirty_day_plan.actions: Use AI to draft a non-sensitive weekly summary. Review every claim and record where human context changes the recommendation.
thirty_day_plan.output: A reviewed draft and an error log.

thirty_day_plan.title: Agree how responsibilities change
thirty_day_plan.actions: Discuss what the team would do with the time released. Set review ownership and escalation rules before changing the routine.
thirty_day_plan.output: An agreed workflow and a named reviewer.

thirty_day_plan.title: Review the evidence
thirty_day_plan.actions: Compare time, quality, and decision usefulness against the original process. Decide whether to continue, adapt, or stop the experiment.
thirty_day_plan.output: A short evidence review and a next-step decision.

result.final_advice: Begin with one reporting workflow, rather than an entire role. Use the time released to improve the quality and speed of decisions, and collect evidence that the change is useful.
